records.name: Desk_Trading_N_Full
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated transparent pixel-art game furniture sprite for BTC Office, Trading Room pack.
Primary request: a very wide empty professional trader desk, seen from the SOUTH at the same fixed slightly elevated orthographic RPG camera as a Stardew-style office. A seated worker will face NORTH, away from the viewer. We see the broad desktop and the front apron and legs. Exactly ONE desk, no other objects, no panels, no labels.
Style: refined hand-pixelled 2D sprite, crisp square 1-pixel steps at a 256 x 128 logical pixel resolution, enlarged exactly 4x with nearest-neighbor to a 1024 x 512 transparent RGBA image. No vector smoothness, no antialiasing, no blur, no gradient. Muted warm honey-oak desktop, warm cream short front apron, charcoal inset cable grommets and slim dark metal legs, subtle limited-palette grain. Small dark brown outline, restrained top-left highlight. Match a cozy existing office game's warm wooden desks, teal chairs, pale cream walls and blue carpet.
Composition: desk spans logical x=8..248, tabletop logical y=16..68, front apron y=68..90, legs y=70..122. Transparent margins around every edge. Symmetrical face-on, horizontal front edge, short tabletop depth from elevated camera, NOT isometric, NOT diagonal. Wide enough for three individual monitors to be placed later. Open space under desk; no chair. Flat floor contact; no cast shadow outside sprite.
Text: none. Avoid computers, screens, keyboard, mouse, chairs, people, books, decorations, room, floor, grid background, checkerboard pixels, logo, watermark. Real alpha transparency, including between legs.

records.name: Chair_Trading_N_Full
records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent RGBA pixel-art furniture sprite for a cozy 2D RPG office trading room. Hard-edged low-resolution pixel art, crisp small square pixels, limited desaturated colors, restrained one-pixel dark outline, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no realistic texture. No people, no characters, no lettering, no logo, no background, no ground shadow, no accessories. Exactly one isolated object, centered with a transparent margin on all four sides.
A professional dark teal upholstered rolling office chair FACING AWAY FROM US toward NORTH. We see the OUTER REAR SHELL of its low-mid backrest, NOT the front cushion of the backrest. A thin rim and a central vertical seam distinguish the rear shell; no headrest. The seat extends forward, away from the viewer, with a small visible strip beyond the rear backrest. Backrest lower and narrower than a person's head; a seated character's head must remain fully visible above it. Clear simple shapes that can later be split into base, cushion, rear backrest and armrests layers. ONE chair, complete, no extra floating parts. Low resolution pixel sprite, enlarged at an integer factor.
